purpose: Describe movement away or a development continuing into the future.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
The bird flew away into the distance.
I will continue studying from now on.
As autumn arrives, it gradually gets colder.
restrictions: The viewpoint establishes what counts as away or onward.
mistake: Do not interpret every ていく as physical departure.
